name: HippoRAG
ontology_notes: Paper 2405.14831 is HippoRAG 1. An open KG of noun-phrase nodes and relation edges extracted by OpenIE from a retrieval corpus, plus synonym edges from a dense encoder. Query named entities seed Personalized PageRank. Ranked units are passages, not user bio, character autobiography, relationship state, lore, or OOC. Current OSU-NLP-Group/HippoRAG main is HippoRAG 2 (arXiv 2502.14802). V1 code is the legacy branch.

ontology.evidence: Paper §2.3 stores OpenIE triples as noun-phrase nodes N and relation edges E, plus synonym edges E'. Code src/hipporag.py HippoRAG on the legacy branch. No companion kinds.
ontology.label: measured

write_policy.evidence: Offline indexing OpenIE-extracts every passage via 1-shot LLM prompts (paper §2.3, src/openie_with_retrieval_option_parallel.py). No refusal of jokes, hypotheticals, or poisoned corpus text.
write_policy.label: measured

read_policy.evidence: Query NER links to KG nodes, then PPR ranks passages (paper §2.3). HippoRAG.rank_docs and run_pagerank_igraph_chunk in src/hipporag.py. Always returns top_k. No retrieve-nothing gate.
read_policy.label: measured

supersession.evidence: New passages add triples. Paper has no delete-on-contradiction or valid_at. Conflicting facts can both sit in the KG.
supersession.label: inferred

temporal.evidence: Corpus is static Wikipedia-style passages for MuSiQue, 2WikiMultiHopQA, HotpotQA (paper §3.1). No validity windows or last-Tuesday queries.
temporal.label: measured

identity_split.evidence: One schemaless KG over a shared passage corpus. No user vs character vs relationship tables in paper or HippoRAG.__init__.
identity_split.label: measured

silence.evidence: rank_docs always injects top_k passages by PPR score. No trauma, spoiler, or skip-relevant-hit control.
silence.label: measured

poisoning.evidence: OpenIE writes whatever the corpus contains into the KG. No provenance or trust tags on triples.
poisoning.label: measured

forgetting.evidence: Paper has no forget-that, decay, or repression. V1 hipporag.py has no delete API. Current main HippoRAG.delete is HippoRAG 2, not this paper.
forgetting.label: measured

cost_shape.evidence: Online turn is query NER plus PPR, then the QA LLM. Paper §4 says single-step HippoRAG is 10-30 times cheaper and 6-13 times faster than IRCoT. Indexing pays one OpenIE LLM pass per passage plus synonym edges.
cost_shape.label: measured

local.evidence: MIT LICENSE. Paper Table 5 runs Llama-3.1-8B/70B OpenIE. Default experiments use GPT-3.5-turbo-1106. Local is possible if you bring the LLM and encoder.
local.label: measured

mcp.evidence: Research repo. No MCP server in main or legacy trees.
mcp.label: measured

companion_fit_reason: Multi-hop QA retriever. Open KG plus PPR still stuffs ranked passages into a reader. No user vs character vs relationship types. No silence. No poisoning filter. Winning 2Wiki recall does not score companion identity.

published_eval.name: MuSiQue, 2WikiMultiHopQA, HotpotQA (1000-question dev samples, IRCoT-style corpora)
published_eval.claimed_score: HippoRAG (ColBERTv2) 2Wiki R@5 89.1 vs ColBERTv2 68.2 (Table 2, about 20 points). QA 2Wiki F1 59.5 vs ColBERTv2 43.3 (Table 4). IRCoT+HippoRAG 2Wiki R@5 93.9.
published_eval.what_it_actually_scores: Multi-hop passage recall (R@2/R@5, all-recall) and extractive QA EM/F1 over Wikipedia-style supporting docs. Not companion identity, silence, or persona poisoning.

open_unknowns: Whether any HippoRAG 1 checkpoint still indexes against current ColBERTv2 and GPT-3.5-turbo-1106 prompts without the HippoRAG 2 rewrite.
Whether synonym threshold tau=0.8 from MuSiQue train tuning transfers to a months-long chat log.
